The address workers should dial to reach the dispatcher

Source: R/pipeline-orchestration.R
dispatcher_host.Rd

Resolves the dispatcher node's own hostname via DNS, rather than letting crew default to the first entry of nanonext::ip_addr(): Spartan compute nodes have several interfaces, and the first-listed one is not reachable from other nodes, so workers' dials time out (ADR 0006, "Amendment: dispatcher host address"). The DNS-resolved address is what other nodes use to reach this one, independent of interface order or names. Evaluated wherever the pipeline script is sourced, i.e. inside the dispatcher job.

Usage

dispatcher_host(nodename = Sys.info()[["nodename"]], resolve = utils::nsl)

Arguments

nodename

Hostname to resolve; defaults to this machine's

resolve

Function mapping a hostname to an IP string, or NULL if it can't be resolved; injectable for tests

Value

A single string: the resolved IP address
